You are a content worker for GRAND THEFT MOTO, a GTA2-style couch crime sandbox in plain JavaScript (no runtime
dependencies), in the repository michaelcrosato/gta25-cco55-my-3d2dge. Your working directory is your own git worktree.

SETUP, first:
  git checkout --detach HEAD_SHA
  [ -e node_modules ] || ln -s /home/user/gta25-cco55-my-3d2dge/node_modules node_modules
  mkdir -p OUT/files
`git log -1 --oneline` must name "M8 (part 1)".

READ FIRST, before writing anything:
- docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md: the recipe table and the whole "Missions" section.
- src/game/missions/s1-holy-rollers.js: the reference mission (passes the bot on seeds 1-3 and through the pad).
- src/motor/mission/dsl.js (the stage contract; the hint kinds the bot plays), src/motor/mission/runtime.js (the
  MissionContext m: its getters, immediate calls and ops), src/motor/mission/actors.js (spawn.vehicle/ped/pickup/prop
  options: tags, roles enemy/guard/ally/flee, drive orders, racers), src/motor/ai/missionbot.js (how the bot plays each
  hint kind; your objectives must be playable from their hints alone).
- PLAN.md 8.15 (the runtime), 9.2-9.5 (cast, gangs, missions, side content), and the parts your task names.
- tools/bot.mjs (the bot runner) and tests/sim/mission-links.test.mjs (deep links, the lint).
- src/game/save.js (the save's shape: m.save is it, read-only for content), src/game/peds/cast.js (the cast's ped ids).

THE WORLD (Lowtown, seed 1999, 2560 x 2560 u, y grows south, a cell is 16 u):
vehicles: bilgerat (boat), brute (car), cortez (car), retiree (car), fedsedan (car, police), cruiser (car, police), eye (heli, police), hauler (truck), medic (truck, medic), rhino (truck, police), strongbox (truck, special), hookline (tow, service, hook), drillrig (tow, service, hook), pumper (truck, fire, cannon), saint (car), sparrow (bike), thel (rail, special), vandal (bike), zephyr (car)
peds: fender [cast] <saints>, bilge [cast] <rats>, nana [cast] <gnomes>, kettle [cast], pennywhistle [cast], lefty [cast], clerk [special], janitor [special], office [civilian], tourist [civilian], jogger [civilian], docker [civilian], retiree [civilian], clubber [civilian], vendor [civilian], skater [civilian], busker [civilian], nightowl [civilian], paramedic [service], firefighter [service], mpd [service], guard [service], swat [service], fed [service], mime [special], saint-grunt [gang], saint-enforcer [gang], rat-grunt [gang], rat-enforcer [gang], gnome-grunt [gang], gnome-enforcer [gang]
weapons: fists, slugger, snub38, buzzsaw, persuader, boomtube, hotmess, partystarter, pineapple, zapomatic, snap
gangs: saints (turf neon, hq saints-hq, phone phone-saints); rats (turf harbor, hq rats-hq, phone phone-rats); gnomes (turf palm, hq gnomes-hq, phone phone-gnomes)
interiors: bank

stations: crash, wheelz, neon, lowdown

POIs: gas-n-sip 760,264; palm-park 1000,360; safehouse 296,760; greasy-spoke 648,808; gnomes-hq 712,1144; phone-gnomes 600,1160; hospital 312,1128; threads 1032,1160; kwik-lux-palm 1128,808; hotel-marquee 1496,424; plaza 1864,296; lead-farm 2184,440; pixel-palace 1464,808; bank-door 1864,792; bank-sewer 1736,712; saints-hq 2216,744; phone-saints 2136,808; precinct 1496,1128; kwik-lux-neon 1928,1160; boom-box 664,1512; loop-gap 232,1464; spray-pray 248,1832; l-depot 1080,1768; car-wash 760,1832; crush-hour 712,2360; fish-market 1496,1512; container-ramp 1784,1544; cranes 2232,1576; kwik-lux-harbor 1544,1832; marina 2200,1848; rats-hq 2360,2296; phone-rats 2152,2232; lighthouse 2376,2344

Where things already are: src/game/districts/lowtown/fleet.js parks the landmarks' vehicles when the city loads
(two cruisers and the Rhino at the precinct, the Medic at the hospital, the Strongbox at the bank door, the Pumper by
the L depot, the Drill Rig by the fish market, the Hookline at Crush Hour, a Vandal at the Greasy Spoke, a Sparrow at
the Gas'n'Sip, the Bilge Rat in the marina's slip...), and curb parking by neighbourhood. A mission that needs its own
vehicle somewhere else makes it (m.ensure.vehicle).

RULES:
- Create ONLY these new files: FILES. Edit no existing file; never touch src/motor, dist/, PROGRESS.md,
  docs/DECISIONS.md or another worker's files. No commits, pushes, branches or other git writes.
- Content registers itself when imported (every .js under src/game is bundled, sorted by path): no index to edit.
- Deterministic: no Math.random, Date or timers; m.rng for chance, m.elapsed / m.stageTime for time.
- The contract: setup(m) is idempotent and runs again on every retry and deep link (ensure.* what must survive a retry,
  spawn.* what is made afresh; place the player near the stage's start when far, as S1 does); run(m) is a generator
  yielding ops; every objective carries a hint the bot can play. Model identifiers never appear in any file.
- Use exactly the ids given below (the lint checks mission ids against the slice's list).
- Handy and easy to miss: m.kill counts a vehicle on fire as done (its blast is coming: the bot backs away from it);
  m.loadout({ ..., only: true }) makes a stage's weapons the player's only ones for the mission (else the bot fights
  with the best gun it already carries); a point [x, y, z] with a height is reached only up there (the Loop's deck).
- MOTOR is off limits. If you need a MOTOR feature or find a MOTOR bug, work around it in content where you can and
  report it in motorRequests with a concrete patch (file, the change, why); you may try a patch locally to prove it,
  but return only your own files and revert any local MOTOR change.

TESTS (run, read, fix your content until they pass):
1. npx eslint src tests tools
2. node tools/boundary-check.mjs
3. node --test tests/sim/mission-links.test.mjs
4. Each mission and activity (each level of an activity: --level N):
   node tools/bot.mjs --mission <id> --seeds 1,2,3     and     node tools/bot.mjs --mission <id> --pad --seeds 1
   While iterating: --stage <stage id> to start at a stage, --verbose (each objective) or --trace (every 10 s), --secs N.
   A run takes minutes (the pad's longest): run it in the background and wait for it; at most two bot runs at a time
   (4 cores shared with another worker).
   The bot is a player's proxy with a pad. If it fails, find out why and make the content fair and clear (spots from
   m.curb / m.lane, hints carrying the data the bot needs, sane timers, fair fights). If it fails for the bot's or
   MOTOR's own reasons, keep the evidence for motorRequests.
   Every mission must pass on seeds 1, 2 and 3 and through the pad on seed 1 (the bot retries a failed stage twice).

PROBES: write any scratch scripts and logs under OUT (outside the repository), importing the harness by its path in
your worktree (import { loadGame } from '<your worktree>/tests/harness.mjs'; loadGame({ hash: '#mission/<id>/<stage>',
query: { seed: '1', bot: '1' } }) gives { game, gtm }: gtm.career, gtm.crew, gtm.fleet, gtm.city, gtm.motor...).

RETURN:
- Copy every file you created to OUT/files/<its repo path> (mkdir -p), and write OUT/notes.md: what you made, how each
  piece plays, the bot runs, any deviation from PLAN.md and why.
- Final answer, the structured result: files (repo paths), runs (every final bot run: id, level, seed, pad, passed,
  medal, secs, note), notes (short), motorRequests ([{ file, change, why }]).

H4 'heist_big_withdrawal', The Big Withdrawal (PLAN.md 9.4: the slice's finale). giver { at: 'safehouse' } (the
planning board in the chapel), requires ['heist_getaway', 'heist_blueprints', 'heist_big_drill'] (another worker writes
those at the same time: they are not in your worktree, and the lint knows their ids), plays 'any' with allowSwitch: true
(all three protagonists: dex, viv, gus; m.as(id) in a setup, m.switchTo(id) as an op), tier 4.
- The plan is a choice (m.choice): LOUD (Gus rams the bank's Strongbox truck, the 'strongbox' vehicle; a shoot-out in
  the bank lobby, the 'bank' interior; 4 stars) or QUIET (Viv through the sewer, the 'bank-sewer' POI, alarms off; Gus
  drills from below; 2 stars). QUIET is offered only with +40 respect with the gang that supplies its hacker or its
  driver (say the Rats' hacker or the Saints' driver: m.save.respect).
- Both end in a SIDE-SCROLL MODE 7 getaway on the Loop (m.view('side7') for the set piece; back to 'iso' after). The
  Loop is the elevated ring road: its lanes are in the road graph at deck height (z > 0: list them with a probe over
  roadsOf(city).graph.lanes); m.lane(at, heading, z) snaps to a deck lane; reach and race points [x, y, z] count the
  height, and the bot routes up there. Switch between Dex driving (the getaway car: the Zephyr H1 stashed,
  m.garaged('getaway'), or a fresh one if it's gone), Viv shooting from the window (a passenger: the bot shoots out of
  the window at a 'kill' target when seated as a passenger: m.place(m.crewPed('viv'), { in: car, seat: 1 }) and so on),
  and Gus clearing a roadblock with the tow truck (a ram, or a tow).
- Then the split of the take (the reward's cash goes to the crew fund), the results (the JOB DONE card shows the medal
  and the bonuses), and the credits ("District 2: coming soon": m.say lines or a cutscene).
- The bot plays with a fixed choice (choice(..., { bot: 'loud' })): give each branch's stages deep links that work on
  their own (a stage's setup sets m.data.plan when started directly) and bot-test both branches (--stage).
- Rewards: a big take (around $60,000), respect +10 to the gang that helped. Keep it fair for the bot: wanted levels
  with allowWanted where the stage is a getaway, fights with a given loadout.

- R1 'rats_rat_run', Rat Run: giver { phone: 'rats' }, gang 'rats', tier 1, requires ['prologue'], plays any. Take a
  contraband van (a 'hauler') to the Brickyard without being seen arriving: 2 stars the moment you take it
  (m.wanted.set(2)); lose them before the drop (failIf the player reaches the drop with stars: 'they saw you arrive');
  the Spray & Pray respray ('spray-pray', a drive-in shop) is one way to. The drop: a yard in the Brickyard (crush-hour,
  or near boom-box). Proves wanted, evade, respray. (The bot loses stars first on a deliver unless a timer runs or the
  stage allows them: exactly what R1 asks.) Unlocks the Persuader (the arsenal's unlock 'rats_rat_run'). Rewards about
  $2,500, rats +15, gnomes -5.
- R2 'rats_below_deck', Below Deck: requires ['rats_rat_run'], tier 2, plays 'viv'. Sneak into the Saints' chop shop and
  photograph the ledger. There is no chop-shop landmark: use an existing yard (the boom-box yard, the container yard,
  club-chrome's plaza) and build its cover from mission props (crates, pallets, barrels, scaffold: m.spawn.prop), with
  guards (role 'guard', facing or a route) and the ledger (a prop or a point) to photograph with the Snap (m.loadout({
  weapons: ['snap'] }), m.photo(target, { from })). Outdoors a guard who sees you fights: make being seen a fail
  (failIf alerted: 'they made you'), then a retry. Takedowns from behind (the bot takes down an unalerted guard close
  behind it). The bot plays a 'stealth' hint ({ kind: 'stealth', path: [[x, y], ...] }) crouched along the path: lay it
  behind the guards' backs and out of their sight cones (E.sees: range and a field of view). Proves stealth, takedowns,
  the Snap. Rewards about $3,500, rats +15, saints -10.
- R3 'rats_crane_game', Crane Game: requires ['rats_below_deck'], tier 3. Hold the container yard (landmark
  container-yard; the cranes nearby) against a Saints assault: waves of saint-grunt enemies on foot and in cars (m.kill
  on each wave's tag), Molotovs (partystarter) and barrels about, fire; then chase their leader (a car fleeing: drive {
  flee: 'player' }; m.chase or m.kill on its tag). Give the player a fair loadout (m.loadout) and armor; allies welcome
  (role 'ally'). Proves combat waves, cover-lite, Molotovs and barrels, fire, the chase. Unlocks the Hot Mess (unlock
  'rats_crane_game'). Rewards about $5,000, rats +20, saints -10.

- G1 'gnomes_lawn_order', Lawn Order: giver { phone: 'gnomes' }, gang 'gnomes', tier 1, requires ['prologue'], plays
  'gus'. Smash 8 Saints cars in Palm Terraces with a bat in 2:00: m.timer(120); m.loadout({ weapons: ['slugger'],
  select: 'slugger', only: true }) (the bat alone: the player's own weapons back at the end); Saints cars ('saint', 'zephyr') parked at curbs about the hood (m.curb); m.kill on their tag, {
  count: 8 } (the bot walks up to a parked car and beats it). Proves melee against vehicles, property-damage heat, the
  timer (with a timer running the bot doesn't stop to lose stars). Unlocks the Pineapple (unlock 'gnomes_lawn_order').
  Rewards about $2,500, gnomes +15, saints -5.
- G2 'gnomes_bingo_night', Bingo Night: requires ['gnomes_lawn_order'], tier 2. A police raid at night (m.time(h) sets
  the hour): pick up Nana (the 'nana' cast ped) at Gutterball Lanes in her slow Retiree wagon ('retiree'; she rides along)
  and escape 3 stars (m.wanted.set(3): the Eye's spotlight, roadblocks) to a safe spot, then lose them (m.evade).
  m.allowWanted() while the escape needs the stars. Proves 3 stars with the chopper, roadblocks, night, a heavy car.
  Rewards about $3,500, gnomes +15.
- G3 'gnomes_gutter_ball', Gutter Ball: requires ['gnomes_bingo_night'], tier 3. Firebomb the Rats' boathouse (the
  boathouse landmark on the pier: Molotovs, m.loadout partystarter; m.fire / m.heat set and check its fires), survive
  the counter-attack (rat-grunt waves), escape by speedboat (the 'bilgerat' boat: a player's choice, but the bot doesn't
  sail) or by road (the bot's way: a point inland). Proves fire spread, explosions, boats, a gang war. Unlocks the Boom
  Tube (unlock 'gnomes_gutter_ball'). Rewards about $5,000, gnomes +20, rats -15.

Activities (defActivity; read the shape in src/motor/mission/dsl.js; the economy and completion in PLAN.md 8.16 and
src/game/economy.js): the same staged form, with a level.
- Jobs, kind 'job', levels 3, repeatable, started from the phone when in the job's vehicle (start: { vehicle: [...] }:

- S2 'saints_confession_booth', Confession Booth: giver { phone: 'saints' }, gang 'saints', tier 2, requires

P0 'prologue', Two Wheels, No Brakes (PLAN.md 9.4): the onboarding mission a new game starts. giver { intro: true, at:
